newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy '96 PSBR might exceed 123 trln lire-Treasury.
newsitem.headline: Italy '96 PSBR might exceed 123 trln lire-Treasury.

text.p: Italy's 1996 public sector deficit might exceed the latest government target of 123 trillion lire, Treasury undersecretary Filippo Cavazzuti said.

"The risk of overshooting the 123 trillion lire deficit figure for 1996 is now unfortunately a given fact," Cavazzuti was quoted as saying in a parliamentary bulletin, taken from proceedings at Wednesday's budget committee hearing.
The government upgraded its 1996 public sector borrowing requirement (PSBR) target to 123 trillion lire from a previous 113 trillion lire.
Bank of Italy governor Antonio Fazio warned earlier this month that the 1996 PSBR might be over 130 trillion lire.
The PSBR target for 1997 is 62.5 trillion lire.

"The government is betting on a reduction in interest rate differentials. This will allow Italy to immediately re-enter the European Exchange Rate Mechanism (ERM)," Cavazzuti was quoted as saying. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
